name: Update Apple Spec

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/update.yml
      - specs/**
      - update/**
  schedule:
    # Runs at 10:00 and 20:00 UTC daily
    - cron: "0 10,20 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows manual triggering

permissions:
  contents: write # Needed for creating pull requests
  pull-requests: write # Needed for PR operations
  issues: write # Needed for failure notifications

jobs:
  update-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check Last-Modified
        id: head_check
        working-directory: update
        run: |
          REMOTE=$(curl -sSfI "https://developer.apple.com/sample-code/app-store-connect/app-store-connect-openapi-specification.zip" \
            | awk -F': ' 'tolower($1)=="last-modified" {sub(/\r$/,"",$2); print $2}')
          LOCAL=$(cat last-modified.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n' || echo "")
          echo "remote: $REMOTE"
          echo "local:  $LOCAL"
          if [ -n "$REMOTE" ] && [ "$REMOTE" = "$LOCAL" ]; then
            echo "Spec unchanged since $LOCAL — skipping."
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "remote_last_modified=$REMOTE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Set up Bun
        if: steps.head_check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.head_check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: update

      - name: Run update script
        if: steps.head_check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        id: update
        working-directory: update
        run: |
          bun run ./index.ts
          printf '%s\n' "${{ steps.head_check.outputs.remote_last_modified }}" > last-modified.txt
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set Apple API version
        if: steps.update.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        working-directory: update
        run: echo "APPLE_API_VERSION=$(cat apple-api-version.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Read diff summary
        if: steps.update.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        working-directory: update
        run: |
          if [ -f diff-summary.md ]; then
            {
              echo 'DIFF_SUMMARY<<EOF'
              cat diff-summary.md
              echo ''
              echo 'EOF'
            } >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Check for existing PR
        if: steps.update.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        id: check_pr
        run: |
          EXISTING_PR=$(gh pr list --head "spec/update-v${{ env.APPLE_API_VERSION }}" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [ -n "$EXISTING_PR" ]; then
            echo "PR #$EXISTING_PR already exists for v${{ env.APPLE_API_VERSION }}"
            echo "pr_exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "pr_exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.update.outputs.has_update == 'true' && steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_exists != 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update App Store Connect API to v${{ env.APPLE_API_VERSION }}"
          base: main
          branch: spec/update-v${{ env.APPLE_API_VERSION }}
          title: "chore: update App Store Connect API to v${{ env.APPLE_API_VERSION }}"
          body: |
            Updates the App Store Connect API specification to version ${{ env.APPLE_API_VERSION }}.

            ## Changes

            ${{ env.DIFF_SUMMARY }}

            ---

            See the [App Store Connect API documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi) for more details.

            This PR was auto-generated by the Update Apple Spec workflow.
          reviewers: EvanBacon
          labels: automerge, api-update
          add-paths: |
            specs/*.json
            update/apple-api-version.txt
            update/last-modified.txt

      - name: Commit last-modified bump (no version change)
        if: steps.head_check.outputs.changed == 'true' && steps.update.outputs.has_update != 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add update/last-modified.txt
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: bump Apple spec Last-Modified (no version change)"
            git push
          fi

  notify-failure:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: update-spec
    if: failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - name: Create failure issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `Spec update workflow failed on ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`;
            // Check if an open issue already exists
            const { data: issues } = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'workflow-failure',
              per_page: 1,
            });
            if (issues.length > 0) {
              // Comment on existing issue instead of creating a new one
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: issues[0].number,
                body: `Workflow failed again: ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title,
                body: `The scheduled spec update workflow has failed.\n\nRun: ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}\n\nPlease investigate.`,
                labels: ['workflow-failure'],
              });
            }

name: E2E Build Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "packages/apple-targets/**"
      - "packages/create-target/templates/**"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - run: bun install --ignore-scripts

      - name: Build packages
        run: bun run prepare

      - name: Cache DerivedData
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData
          key: deriveddata-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/apple-targets/e2e/fixture/**') }}
          restore-keys: |
            deriveddata-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Run E2E build tests
        run: bun run test:e2e
        working-directory: packages/apple-targets

name: Publish stable to npm

on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish-stable:
    if: github.repository == 'EvanBacon/serve-sim' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: macos-26
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Require main branch
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.ref }}" != "refs/heads/main" ]; then
            echo "::error::Stable publishes must run from main."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          # Pin via .bun-version: resolving "latest" hits GitHub's
          # git/refs/tags API, which 503s during GitHub incidents.
          bun-version-file: .bun-version

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      # Test-phase build is arm64-only; boot overlaps it. The publish step below
      # rebuilds without SERVE_SIM_ARCH so the npm tarball stays universal.
      - name: Build serve-sim (arm64) and boot simulator
        id: ci-build
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-serve-sim-for-ci
        with:
          arch: arm64

      - name: serve-sim Darwin tests
        env:
          UDID: ${{ steps.ci-build.outputs.udid }}
          # Camera e2e clang uses parseServeSimArch(); default is universal (fat).
          SERVE_SIM_ARCH: arm64
        run: bun packages/serve-sim/scripts/run-sim-e2e.ts

      - name: Shutdown simulator
        if: always() && steps.ci-build.outputs.udid != ''
        run: |
          xcrun simctl shutdown "${{ steps.ci-build.outputs.udid }}" || true

      - name: Build and publish serve-sim stable
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cd packages/serve-sim

          # Stable publishing is manual-only. Bump from max(local, npm latest)
          # + 1, publish to npm's latest tag, then commit that stable version.
          LOCAL=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          PUBLISHED=$(npm view serve-sim dist-tags.latest 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          [ -z "$PUBLISHED" ] && PUBLISHED="$LOCAL"
          NEW=$(node -e "
            const a='$LOCAL'.split('.').map(Number);
            const b='$PUBLISHED'.split('.').map(Number);
            const max=(a[0]>b[0]||(a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]>b[1])||(a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]===b[1]&&a[2]>b[2]))?a:b;
            max[2]++;
            console.log(max.join('.'));
          ")
          echo "Bumped serve-sim stable: local=$LOCAL npm=$PUBLISHED -> $NEW"
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));
            p.version = '$NEW';
            fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n');
          "

          bun run build

          npm publish --access public --tag latest --provenance

      - name: Configure git and commit stable version bump
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add packages/serve-sim/package.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No version bump to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "chore: bump serve-sim version [skip ci]"
            for i in 1 2 3; do
              if git push; then exit 0; fi
              echo "Push rejected (attempt $i/3), rebasing on origin/main..."
              git pull --rebase --autostash origin main || break
            done
            # main is a protected branch, so github-actions[bot] can't push the
            # bump commit directly. That's fine: npm has already been advanced and
            # the next run recomputes the version from npm's latest tag, so it never
            # collides. The repo's package.json just stays behind npm. Warn instead
            # of failing so the publish job reflects the (successful) npm publish.
            echo "::warning::Could not push serve-sim version bump to protected main; npm already advanced and the next run recomputes from npm. Leaving package.json behind."
          fi

name: Publish beta to npm

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "packages/serve-sim/**"
      - ".github/workflows/publish.yml"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish-beta:
    if: github.repository == 'EvanBacon/serve-sim' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: macos-26
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Detect serve-sim changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "sim=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Publish beta if serve-sim source changed.
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          SOURCE_CHANGED=false
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^packages/serve-sim/"; then
            SOURCE_CHANGED=true
          fi

          if [ "$SOURCE_CHANGED" = "true" ]; then
            echo "sim=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "sim=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Setup bun
        if: steps.changes.outputs.sim == 'true'
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version-file: .bun-version

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.changes.outputs.sim == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.changes.outputs.sim == 'true'
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      # Test-phase build is arm64-only; boot overlaps it. The publish step below
      # rebuilds without SERVE_SIM_ARCH so the npm tarball stays universal.
      - name: Build serve-sim (arm64) and boot simulator
        if: steps.changes.outputs.sim == 'true'
        id: ci-build
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-serve-sim-for-ci
        with:
          arch: arm64

      - name: serve-sim Darwin tests
        if: steps.changes.outputs.sim == 'true'
        env:
          UDID: ${{ steps.ci-build.outputs.udid }}
          # Camera e2e clang uses parseServeSimArch(); default is universal (fat).
          SERVE_SIM_ARCH: arm64
        run: bun packages/serve-sim/scripts/run-sim-e2e.ts

      - name: Shutdown simulator
        if: always() && steps.ci-build.outputs.udid != ''
        run: |
          xcrun simctl shutdown "${{ steps.ci-build.outputs.udid }}" || true

      - name: Build and publish serve-sim beta
        if: steps.changes.outputs.sim == 'true'
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cd packages/serve-sim

          # Publish a unique prerelease from max(local, npm latest) + 1.
          # This keeps automatic main pushes on npm's beta tag until stable
          # promotion is requested explicitly.
          LOCAL=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          PUBLISHED=$(npm view serve-sim dist-tags.latest 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          [ -z "$PUBLISHED" ] && PUBLISHED="$LOCAL"
          NEW=$(node -e "
            const a='$LOCAL'.split('.').map(Number);
            const b='$PUBLISHED'.split('.').map(Number);
            const max=(a[0]>b[0]||(a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]>b[1])||(a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]===b[1]&&a[2]>b[2]))?a:b;
            max[2]++;
            console.log(max.join('.') + '-beta.${{ github.run_number }}.${{ github.run_attempt }}');
          ")
          echo "Bumped serve-sim: local=$LOCAL npm=$PUBLISHED -> $NEW"
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));
            p.version = '$NEW';
            fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n');
          "

          bun run build

          npm publish --access public --tag beta --provenance

name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "bin/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "tsconfig.build.json"
      - ".github/workflows/publish.yml"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun test

  publish:
    needs: [test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Detect changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          # Publish if source changed OR local version differs from npm
          # (gap state from a previous run that published but failed to
          # push the bump back to main).
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          SOURCE_CHANGED=false
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -qE "^(src/|bin/|package\.json|tsconfig\.build\.json)"; then
            SOURCE_CHANGED=true
          fi

          LOCAL=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          NPM_V=$(npm view inspect-webkit version 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GAP=false
          if [ -n "$NPM_V" ] && [ "$NPM_V" != "$LOCAL" ]; then
            echo "inspect-webkit gap: local=$LOCAL npm=$NPM_V"
            GAP=true
          fi

          if [ "$SOURCE_CHANGED" = "true" ] || [ "$GAP" = "true" ]; then
            echo "publish=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "publish=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Setup bun
        if: steps.changes.outputs.publish == 'true'
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: steps.changes.outputs.publish == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.changes.outputs.publish == 'true'
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build and publish
        if: steps.changes.outputs.publish == 'true'
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Bump from max(local, npm-published) + 1 so a previous run that
          # published but failed to push the bump back to main can't poison
          # the next run with a 403 from npm.
          LOCAL=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          PUBLISHED=$(npm view inspect-webkit version 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          [ -z "$PUBLISHED" ] && PUBLISHED="$LOCAL"
          NEW=$(node -e "
            const a='$LOCAL'.split('.').map(Number);
            const b='$PUBLISHED'.split('.').map(Number);
            const max=(a[0]>b[0]||(a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]>b[1])||(a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]===b[1]&&a[2]>b[2]))?a:b;
            max[2]++;
            console.log(max.join('.'));
          ")
          echo "Bumped inspect-webkit: local=$LOCAL npm=$PUBLISHED -> $NEW"
          node -e "
            const fs = require('fs');
            const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));
            p.version = '$NEW';
            fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n');
          "

          bun run build

          npm publish --access public

      - name: Configure git and commit version bump
        if: steps.changes.outputs.publish == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add package.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No version bump to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "chore: bump inspect-webkit version [skip ci]"
            for i in 1 2 3; do
              if git push; then exit 0; fi
              echo "Push rejected (attempt $i/3), rebasing on origin/main..."
              git pull --rebase --autostash origin main || break
            done
            echo "::error::Failed to push version bump after 3 attempts. npm has been advanced; next run will self-heal."
            exit 1
          fi

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Type check
        run: bun x tsc --noEmit

      - name: Build bundle
        run: bun run build

      - name: Verify bundle exists
        run: test -f build/cli.mjs

      - name: Test bundled CLI help
        run: ./build/cli.mjs --help

      - name: Test bundled CLI list
        run: ./build/cli.mjs --list --platform ios

      - name: Generate iOS app (bundled)
        run: ./build/cli.mjs TestApp -p ios --org com.ci.test -y -o /tmp/ci-test

      - name: Generate macOS app (bundled)
        run: ./build/cli.mjs MacTestApp -p macos --org com.ci.test -y -o /tmp/ci-test

      - name: Generate iOS app with SwiftData (bundled)
        run: ./build/cli.mjs SwiftDataApp -p ios --org com.ci.test --storage swiftdata -y -o /tmp/ci-test

      - name: Build iOS app (xcodebuild)
        run: |
          xcodebuild -project /tmp/ci-test/TestApp/TestApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme TestApp \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            -quiet build

      - name: Build macOS app (xcodebuild)
        run: |
          xcodebuild -project /tmp/ci-test/MacTestApp/MacTestApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme MacTestApp \
            -destination 'platform=macOS' \
            -quiet build

      - name: Build SwiftData app (xcodebuild)
        run: |
          xcodebuild -project /tmp/ci-test/SwiftDataApp/SwiftDataApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme SwiftDataApp \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            -quiet build

  extract:
    name: Extract templates (verify extractor)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run extractor
        run: bun scripts/extract-templates.ts

      - name: Verify manifest was generated
        run: |
          test -f templates/manifest.json
          echo "Template count:"
          bun -e "const m = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('templates/manifest.json','utf8')); console.log(m.templates.length, 'templates from Xcode', m.xcodeVersion)"

      - name: Build bundle from fresh templates
        run: bun run build

      - name: Generate and build with fresh templates
        run: |
          ./build/cli.mjs FreshApp -p ios --org com.ci.test -y -o /tmp/ci-fresh
          xcodebuild -project /tmp/ci-fresh/FreshApp/FreshApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme FreshApp \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            -quiet build

name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/mdx/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish.yml'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Bump version
        working-directory: packages/mdx
        run: |
          # Get current version and bump patch
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "const v='$CURRENT_VERSION'.split('.'); v[2]=parseInt(v[2])+1; v.join('.')")
          # Update package.json directly
          node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')); p.version='$NEW_VERSION'; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2)+'\n')"
          echo "Bumped version: $CURRENT_VERSION -> $NEW_VERSION"
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build package
        working-directory: packages/mdx
        run: bun run build

      - name: Commit version bump
        run: |
          git add packages/mdx/package.json
          git commit -m "chore: bump @bacons/mdx to v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }} [skip ci]"
          git push

      - name: Publish to npm
        working-directory: packages/mdx
        run: npm publish --provenance --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
